sentences.cn_text: 富有启发、充满挑战、令人振奋、趣味盎然。
sentences.en_text: Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun.

sentences.cn_text: 这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作伙伴关系的文章中，用来描述其艺术与科学合作经历的部分词汇。
sentences.en_text: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.

sentences.cn_text: 在参与相关调查的约350人中，近40%表示他们曾与艺术家合作过；几乎所有人都表示未来会考虑这样做。
sentences.en_text: Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said, they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.

sentences.cn_text: 如此令人振奋的结果并不令人意外。
sentences.en_text: Such an encouraging result is not surprising.

sentences.cn_text: 科学家们越来越多地寻求视觉艺术家的帮助，以便将自己的研究成果传递给新的受众。
sentences.en_text: Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them to communicate their work to new audiences.

sentences.cn_text: 一位受访者说：「艺术家帮助科学家接触到更广泛的受众，并建立起增强学习效果的情感联系。」
sentences.en_text: “Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning.” One respondent said.

sentences.cn_text: 艺术家与科学家携手震撼感官的一个范例发生在上个月，当时悉尼交响乐团演奏了重新改编的安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》。
sentences.en_text: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the senses came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons.

sentences.cn_text: 他们通过注入莫纳什大学气候变化传播研究中心提供的每个季节的最新气候预测数据，重新诠释了这部有300年历史的乐谱。
sentences.en_text: They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season — provided by Monash University’s Climate Change Communication Research Hub.

sentences.cn_text: 这场演出是为即将在英国格拉斯哥举行的11月联合国气候变化大会发出的创造性行动呼吁。
sentences.en_text: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November’s United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.

sentences.cn_text: 但真正的合作伙伴关系必须是双向的。
sentences.en_text: But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street.

sentences.cn_text: 参与《自然》杂志调查的艺术家人数少于科学家；然而，一些受访者指出，艺术家并非仅仅是协助科学家满足其传播需求。
sentences.en_text: Fewer artist than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的作品也不应仅仅被当作研究对象。
sentences.en_text: Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study.

sentences.cn_text: 当科学家与艺术家在一个项目中拥有共同利益关系、能够共同设计项目并能够批判彼此的工作时，这种联盟才是最有价值的。
sentences.en_text: The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other’s work.

sentences.cn_text: 这种方式既能激发新的研究，也能产生有影响力的艺术作品。
sentences.en_text: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.

sentences.cn_text: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院开设了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索技术在文化中的作用。
sentences.en_text: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.

sentences.cn_text: 创始人有意将其项目聚焦于光——因此名称中有「视觉研究」一词。
sentences.en_text: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light — hence the “visual studies” in the name.

sentences.cn_text: 光是艺术家与科学家均感兴趣的事物，因而可以构成合作的基础。
sentences.en_text: Light was a something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration.

sentences.cn_text: 随着科学技术的发展并分化为更多子学科，该中心同时也在展望这样一个时代：那时的顶尖研究者同样可以是艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。
sentences.en_text: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.

sentences.cn_text: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然强劲，但要使合作取得成效，双方都需要投入时间，并愿意接受意外收获与挑战。
sentences.en_text: Nature’s poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time and embrace surprise and challenge.

sentences.cn_text: 艺术与科学结合的范围需要超越研究传播这一必要目的，参与者必须避免陷入相互刻板印象的陷阱。
sentences.en_text: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other.

sentences.cn_text: 艺术家与科学家都投身于发现与创造，挑战与批判同样是两者的核心。
sentences.en_text: Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第一段，艺术与科学的合作____。
sentences.en_text: According to paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ____

sentences.cn_text: 引起了批评家的关注
sentences.en_text: caught the attention of critics.

sentences.cn_text: 获得了良好的反响
sentences.en_text: received favorable responses.

sentences.cn_text: 促进了学术出版
sentences.en_text: promoted academic publishing.

sentences.cn_text: 引发了激烈的公众争议
sentences.en_text: sparked heated public disputes.

sentences.cn_text: 提到《四季》的改编版本是为了说明____。
sentences.en_text: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ____

sentences.cn_text: 艺术可以为观众提供接触科学的便捷途径
sentences.en_text: art can offer audiences easy access to science.

sentences.cn_text: 科学可以帮助表达情感
sentences.en_text: science can help with the expression of emotions.

sentences.cn_text: 公众参与科学有着广阔的前景
sentences.en_text: public participation in science has a promising future.

sentences.cn_text: 艺术在促进科学创新方面颇为有效
sentences.en_text: art is effective in facilitating scientific innovations.

sentences.cn_text: 一些艺术家似乎担心在艺术与科学的合作中____。
sentences.en_text: Some artists seem to worry about in the art-science partnership ____

sentences.cn_text: 他们的作用可能被低估
sentences.en_text: their role may be underestimated.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的声誉可能受损
sentences.en_text: their reputation may be impaired.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的创造力可能受到抑制
sentences.en_text: their creativity may be inhibited.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的工作可能被误导
sentences.en_text: their work may be misguided.

sentences.cn_text: 作者对CAVS有何看法？
sentences.en_text: What does the author say about CAVS?

sentences.cn_text: 它由艺术家与科学家交替领导
sentences.en_text: It was headed alternately by artists and scientists.

sentences.cn_text: 它体现了有价值的艺术与科学联盟
sentences.en_text: It exemplified valuable art-science alliances.

sentences.cn_text: 它的项目旨在推进视觉研究
sentences.en_text: Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies.

sentences.cn_text: 其创始人力图提升艺术家的地位
sentences.en_text: Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.

sentences.cn_text: 在最后一段中，作者认为艺术与科学的合作____。
sentences.en_text: In the last paragraph, the author holds that art-science collaborations ____.

sentences.cn_text: 可能会超出公众期望
sentences.en_text: are likely to go beyond public expectations.

sentences.cn_text: 将加剧跨学科竞争
sentences.en_text: will intensify interdisciplinary competition.

sentences.cn_text: 应当超越单纯的科学传播
sentences.en_text: should do more than communicating science.

sentences.cn_text: 正变得比以往更受欢迎
sentences.en_text: are becoming more popular than before.
